also: you may for all I care

terms.gloss: for all I care, as far as I’m concerned
terms.grammar: per with the person whose leave is meant; licet with a subjunctive
evidence: Cic. Ac. 2.93: per mē vel stertās licet (Lewis & Short s.v. per)
terms.comment: “As far as it rests with me”: per mē licet, I don’t mind.
Traupman’s phrase for this sense. Lewis & Short gives meā causā only as “for my sake” (Plaut., Ter., Cic.), so a hearer may take it that way.

phrases.english: you can snore for all I care

sources: Lewis & Short: per · Lewis & Short: licet
